description: Minimized inputs that made the fuzz tests (fuzz/Meziantou.Framework.Imaging.FuzzTests/MutationFuzzTests.cs, and FontFuzzTests.cs for the entries of "kind": "font") fail, and hand-authored variants of the same defects. Malformed-input regressions only: never valid-image pixel references. Validated and replayed by FuzzRegressionTests. See tests/Meziantou.Framework.Imaging.Fixtures/README.md.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group png, base seed 5576998306593010799 (default), 20000 iterations, mutation 7146 of png/gray1-odd-width; minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 101 to 47 bytes
regressions.defect: The zlib header of IDAT sets FDICT (0x78 0x3F): the BCL inflater reports Z_NEED_DICT with its internal ZLibException (an IOException), which escaped Load and readers instead of InvalidImageContentException. Fixed in PngImageDataDecoder.Inflate.

regressions.foundBy: Hand-written well-formed variant of png/idat-zlib-preset-dictionary-min (1x1 gray 8-bit; IDAT zlib header 0x78 0x20 with FDICT and a DICTID, valid chunk CRCs)
regressions.defect: Same defect as png/idat-zlib-preset-dictionary-min; PNG forbids preset dictionaries (PNG specification, 10.1).

regressions.foundBy: Hand-written while fixing png/idat-zlib-preset-dictionary-min: the same inflater error in the metadata decompressor (BoundedInflater) used for iCCP, zTXt and compressed iTXt
regressions.defect: An iCCP profile whose zlib header sets FDICT made identification and loads throw the BCL's internal ZLibException; a malformed ancillary payload must be ignored. Fixed in BoundedInflater.TryInflateZlib.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group hevc-intra, base seed 1001, 20000 iterations, mutation 6741 of hevc/kvazaar-sao-band-64x64 (the stream wrapped by FuzzHeicContainer, a parameter set of the configuration record replaced by the one of another stream); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: The sequence parameter set of the hvcC record (chroma sample location type 5, unsupported) is not the one of the item data, which replaces it for the decoder: full identification read the one of the record and threw UnsupportedImageFeatureException while the loads decoded the picture. Fixed in HeicDecoder.DecodeImage, which checks the parameter set that the identification reads before it decodes.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group hevc-inter, base seed 1001, 20000 iterations, mutation 10251 of hevc/kvazaar-lossless-implicit-rdpcm-64x64 (the stream wrapped by FuzzHeicContainer, a parameter set of the configuration record replaced by the one of another stream); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: The sequence parameter set of the hvcC record of a track has another sample format than the fields of the record, and the samples carry the parameter set of the pictures: full identification threw InvalidImageContentException (the bitstream does not match its configuration record) while the loads decoded the sequence. Fixed in HeicDecoder.CreateDecoder, which checks the first sample of a track as the identification does.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group hevc-intra, base seed 2002, 40000 iterations, mutation 29507 of hevc/x265-intra-atc-recovery-sei-64x64 (the stream wrapped by FuzzHeicContainer, a parameter set of the configuration record replaced by the one of another stream); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: The sequence parameter set of the hvcC record describes 4:2:0 samples with the identity matrix, which is invalid, and the item data carry the parameter set of the picture: header identification threw InvalidImageContentException while the loads decoded the picture with the color description of the other parameter set. Fixed in HeicDecoder: the picture that is decoded must have the sample format and the color description of the parameter set that the identification reads.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group jxl-animated, base seed 5576998306593010799 (default), 1500 iterations, with the transcoding property added to FuzzOracle; minimized by FuzzMinimizer to 27 bytes
regressions.defect: An animation whose first frame is a layer (no duration), without JPEG reconstruction data: JpegXlTranscoder.TryReconstructJpeg stops at the first frame, before any frame is counted, and JpegXlStructureParser built an ImageInfo with a frame count of 0, which threw ArgumentOutOfRangeException instead of returning false. Fixed in JpegXlStructureParser.CreateInfo (the count is unknown).

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group jp2-reversible, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 13013 of jp2/tiles-offsets (reader variant 235); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 2437 to 132 bytes
regressions.defect: A codestream of 8 tiles has the tile-parts of only 1 tile, the last one extending to the EOC marker: full identification threw InvalidImageContentException while the loads decoded the image. The walker reported its walk complete from the EOC marker on, so the decoder finished before the tiles the EOC marker completes were handed over and before the check that every tile is there. Fixed in Jpeg2000CodestreamWalker.IsComplete, which waits for the End event.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group jp2-ht, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 272963 of jp2/ht-tiles (reader variant 235); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 2599 to 2307 bytes
regressions.defect: Same defect as jp2/missing-tiles-min with an HTJ2K codestream that has the tile-parts of 4 of its 6 tiles.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group jpeg-progressive, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 49426 of jpeg/progressive-rgb-adobe (reader variant 143); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 837 to 160 bytes
regressions.defect: A progressive JPEG file whose only scan is a DC scan, with a single Huffman table: JpegXlTranscoder.RecompressJpeg threw InvalidOperationException because the JPEG reconstruction data encode the number of Huffman tables from 2. Fixed in JpegXlJpegReconstructionData.Write, which refuses the file with UnsupportedImageFeatureException.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests groups jxl-lossless and jxl-animated, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 92274 of limit/jxl/total-pixels-hidden-layer (reader variant 191) and mutation 67326 of jxl/anim-layers (reader variant 179); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 62 to 42 bytes
regressions.defect: A shown frame that covers the image and extends beyond it: the decoder wrote its samples as stored, rows wider than the image, and threw IndexOutOfRangeException. Fixed in JpegXlFrameRenderer.NeedsBlending: a frame that does not have the origin and the size of the image is cropped to it, as libjxl does for a frame with a custom size or origin.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group avif-sequence, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 8399 of avif/sequence-8-frames-444-slow (reader variant 158); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: The runs of the 'stts' box of the track describe 24 samples, the 'stsz' box 8: the identification counted the 13 images the edit list shows over the 24 durations while the loads decoded the 8 samples. Fixed in HeifMovieBox.ParseSampleTable: a run that goes beyond the last sample describes no other sample (ISO/IEC 14496-12, section 8.6.1.2).

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group avif-sequence, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 40785 of invalid/avif/sequence-edit-shows-nothing (reader variant 57); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: Same defect as avif/stts-beyond-samples: a run of 1,048,577 samples for a track of 3 made the identification count 2 images in an edit that starts after the last sample, and the loads threw InvalidOperationException (no displayed frame). The edit list now shows no image, which identification and loads report.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group avif-sequence, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 94258 of avif/sequence-edits-fraction (reader variant 111); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: Same defect as avif/stts-beyond-samples: a run of 1,728,053,249 samples for a track of 6 under an edit list that selects parts of the media made full identification exceed the frame limit while the loads decoded 6 images.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group heic-sequence, weekly campaign (run 39012479568), base seed 39012479568, 420 s, mutation 69864 of invalid/heic/sequence-ctts-collision (reader variant 64); not reducible by FuzzMinimizer, which moves the offsets of the container
regressions.defect: The first sample of the track is presented last (composition offset 67,108,868) and the only edit starts at the presentation time of the second one: header identification, which locates the first sample only, took its time for the first presentation time and threw UnsupportedImageFeatureException while full identification and the loads accepted the edit list. Fixed in HeifMovieBox: the first presentation time is the smallest one of every sample, located or not.

regressions.foundBy: FontFuzzTests, weekly campaign (run 39448128288), base seed 39448128288, 120 s, mutation 5723 of fonts/synthetic-variable-charstrings; not reducible by FuzzMinimizer (1164 bytes)
regressions.defect: The string of the name record of an axis of fvar is outside the name table: FontFace.GetName threw InvalidFontException while Font was created (CreateAxes), an exception Font.Load does not document. Fixed in NameTable: a record whose string is outside the table is ignored, as if the font did not have it.

regressions.foundBy: FontFuzzTests, weekly campaign (run 39448128288), base seed 39448128288, 120 s, mutation 679 of fonts/trt-gvar-composite; not reducible by FuzzMinimizer (3592 bytes)
regressions.defect: The string of the name record of a named instance of fvar is outside the name table: FontFace.GetName threw InvalidFontException while Font was created (CreateNamedInstances), an exception Font.Load does not document. Fixed in NameTable: a record whose string is outside the table is ignored, as if the font did not have it.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group heic-still, weekly campaign (run 40164893717), base seed 40164893717, 420 s, mutation 33665 of heic/alpha-mpegb-urn (reader variant 83); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 1190 to 20 bytes
regressions.defect: The file type box stores its size in the 64-bit field (0: up to the end of the file) and its major brand, at offset 16, starts with "mi" but is not a brand. DetectFormat, given the whole file, read the four characters of the brand and returned Unknown, while the reader, which detects the format from the first 18 bytes, saw "mi" only, read the file as AVIF and threw InvalidImageContentException (the file type box is too large). Fixed in AvifCodec.MatchesSignature and HeicCodec.MatchesSignature: the first two characters of such a brand decide whatever the length of the prefix.

regressions.foundBy: FuzzTests group heic-sequence, weekly campaign (run 40164893717), base seed 40164893717, 420 s, mutation 301167 of heic/sequence-clap-odd-420 (reader variant 98); minimized by FuzzMinimizer from 1260 to 1254 bytes
regressions.defect: The file ends where the last of the four samples of the track starts, and the decoder outputs the four images from the first three samples: full identification, which waits for the data of every sample, threw InvalidImageContentException (truncated) while the loads ended once the last image was written and decoded the sequence. Fixed in HeifStructureParser.TryAdvanceSequence: a decoding walk waits for the data of the samples that it did not need before it ends.
